records.falsifier: Any projected handle lacks a matching receipt, a path appears twice, more than eight paths appear, ordering is nondeterministic, control receives state, scheduled span gain is below +0.05, file F1 or valid completion degrades, unknown model usage appears, or state increases cumulative model tokens.
records.mechanism: At each dispatched recycle generation, group delivered evidence by source path, retain the eight most recently observed paths and only the newest distinct handle for each path, restore chronological handle order, and label every item as observed rather than relevant. Keep objective, tools, context limits, 96K token cap, terminal validation, and pairing unchanged.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A cumulative path-diverse evidence projection with at most one newest receipt-bound handle for each of eight newest paths preserves more investigation breadth than the Round 22 four-path policy while eliminating duplicate-path frequency, improving GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench quality and completion within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
